smallest_coherent_unit: canonical Plan source -> normalized graph -> deterministic human views and conditional consumer projections -> independent replay admission

objections.statement: Consumer projection has overlapping ownership: the workflow assigns navigation and consumer projections to PlanViewProjector while ExecutionContractProjector separately owns consumer projections.
The candidate requires machine-checkable applicability but does not define the predicate inputs, branches, negative evidence, projection, rehearsal, and failure route for each consumer.
PlanEvidenceResolver and PlanMigrationValidator are conditional boundary adapters, not mandatory stages of the minimum source-to-admission unit.

recomposition.summary: One source compiles one graph. Separate human-view and consumer-contract projectors read that graph and bind its digest. Independent admission recompiles the source, byte-compares every applicable projection, validates negative evidence, and grants no readiness or execution authority.

frame_expiry: Rerun when W1 selection, either W2 candidate file, any consumer contract, native-context rules, Signal Observer machine evidence, or the four Distill v1 schemas change.
claim_ceiling: Read-only Balancer evidence only; no W3 production, Plan acceptance, readiness, or execution authority.
